correctness.rationale: For d>=2, volume-uniform X,Y in the same filled ellipsoid give X-Y=diag(a_i)(U-V); the independent spherical radial part has exact unit-ball overlap moments b_{d,k}, with recurrence 2(d+2k-1)(d+2k-2)/[(d+2k)(d+k)]. Dirichlet(1/2,...,1/2) angular squares yield coefficients c_k=(d/2)_k mu_k/(k! b_{d,k}); the inverse-square formal series recovers ∏(1-a_i²t) through degree d including repetitions. Perturbing the constant coefficient while preserving simple positive roots shows d-1 moments generically insufficient. Uniform coefficient perturbation, Rouché root-component matching, and scaled real-root pairs prove sharp Hölder exponent 1/d near balls. Independent rational calculation from two full-ball Cartesian coordinate moments gave for d=3 squared axes (1,2,4): mu=(14/5,312/25,12864/175), inverse polynomial 1-7t+14t²-8t³. Finite d=3 check corroborates, not the all-dimensional proof.
